title: Urinary symptoms
summary: Burning or urgency when urinating: possible bladder infection. Fever or chills with flank pain: possible kidney infection. Severe flank pain in waves or visible blood: a stone is among the causes. Sudden inability to urinate: possible acute retention. Sample pH, conductivity, RGB color and temperature, on their own, only describe the sample: they do not indicate blood, body temperature, infection or radiation. Informational support only: not a diagnosis or a treatment decision. There are no clinical personnel on board: the steps are first aid and monitoring; treatment depends on mission procedures.

steps.text: Call for emergency help now using the mission's means (ship alarm, crew, mission control if the link is up). Do not wait to see if it improves.
